messages:
Iris: Quick flag — VanguardHealth says their private deploy renewal invoice includes an unexpected platform fee surcharge labeled 'support uplift'.
Tom: Can you paste the invoice snippet?
Iris: ```INV-80123
PLATFORM_FEE | Annual | $45,000
SUPPORT_UPLIFT | Applied | $7,500
```
Nadia: Did Sales add that uplift? It looks like an AE-level support add-on but Vanguard says they never approved it.
Tom: CRM shows no support uplift addendum on the account. Looks like a pricing experiment toggle accidentally enabled for renewals in the billing rules.
billing-bot: Pricing rule toggle 'support_uplift_experiment_v2' fired for account vanguard-001 on invoice generation.
Nadia: That toggle was for a closed beta; should never run for existing private deployments. We need to void the line.
Iris: The invoice is paid (stripe_tx_z12). Customer wants the line removed and a corrected renewal invoice before renewal comms.
Omar: Finance policy — for disputed add-on charges we create a credit note. For >$5k we need manager approval. Looping @Nadia and @Tom for a decision.
Tom: I approve issuing CN-80123-1 for -$7,500 and creating a corrected invoice for renewal. Also file a postmortem on the experiment gating.
Nadia: I'll disable the toggle and open a bug: BILLING-3555. Also will update the experiment whitelist.
Iris: Notifying CS to tell Vanguard we corrected billing, credit issued, corrected renewal updated.
billing-bot: Credit note CN-80123-1 created. Pending refund? No refund needed (customer prefers credit against renewal).
Omar: I'll update GL so our forecast excludes the uplift. Closing loop after BILLING-3555 posts root cause.
